sloka: सुखसुप्ता त्वया सार्धं जानकी पूर्वमुत्थिता ।वायसः सहसोत्पत्य विरराद स्तनान्तरे ।। ५.६७.३ ।।।।
transliteration: sukhasuptā tvayā sārdhaṁ jānakī pūrvamutthitā ।vāyasaḥ sahasotpatya virarāda stanāntare ।। 5.67.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "When she was lying on your lap happily she awoke early and a crow came swiftly and scratched on her breast.
